rows.en:
I hear you've been getting close to that man
lately...? I've heard the rumors.
rows.notes: ext_rnk_007, both genders; 'that man' version of c03129.

rows.en: (So today's a co-ed pool day, huh...)
Is it just me, or are there way too many people here...?

We've got Sheryl in our class, after all.
No wonder there's such a big crowd watching.

I see...
Looks like a few of the girls are here for you
too, Michel.

rows.notes: Luca to Michel (the girls squeal at Michel).

rows.en: Man, I really don't know where to look.

rows.notes: Luca here (both genders); also the player in frd_itk_115.

rows.en: You've only got eyes for Nanase, right, Luca?

Wh-wh-wh-why are you suddenly bringing up
Nanase-san!?
What do you mean, why? Isn't it obvious?
...I-I have no idea what you mean!!

rows.notes: Asked of both genders; the choices are Sheryl, Ranka, Nanase.
Luca turns the teasing back on the player.
Sheryl and Ranka branches, both genders.

rows.en:
She's just got that aura, you know?
The Galactic Fairy is the best!
Looks like she doesn't hate you, at least.
I've got nothing but a bad feeling about this...
Let's go for a swim too.
Oh? Didn't see that one coming.
She's like a little sister you just wanna protect...

rows.notes: Ranka and Nanase branches, both genders.

rows.en:
Sheryl feels kind of out of reach. Her aura's
so intense, I can't even get close to her.

...So you like Ranka-chan better than me.
Hmph...
Welp, Luca... Shall we go for a swim!

Why don't you tell me all about it?
This reason of yours for picking Ranka-chan...
I'll make you wanna protect ME~!
As if anyone's coming to save you...

She's on the reserved side, but she's great,
you know...

...So you like Nanase better than me.
Hmph...

Why don't you tell me all about it?
This reason of yours for picking Nanase...
Well, sorry for not being the reserved type...
Is it just me, or are there a ton of people here...?

I see...
Looks like a few of the girls are here for you
too, Michel.

Hmmmm...
Just what you'd expect from an academy with
a Performing Arts Course... The bar's way too high...
rows.notes: Female player sizing up the girls at the pool; 'level' rendered 'the bar'.

rows.en: You've only got eyes for Nanase, right, Luca-kun?
(Wh-why are you asking me, of all people...?)
rows.notes: Female player asked which girl she likes.

rows.en:
She's just got that aura, you know?
The Galactic Fairy is the best!
